explanation: Gervais created the series with Stephen Merchant. Its US remake swapped Brent for Steve Carell's Michael Scott, and Martin Freeman played the British show's salesman, Tim.

claims.text: Ricky Gervais played David Brent in the original British series The Office (2001).
Steve Carell, Martin Freeman and Stephen Merchant did not play David Brent.
Ricky Gervais and Stephen Merchant created The Office.
In the US remake of The Office, Steve Carell played the boss, Michael Scott.
Martin Freeman played Tim, a sales representative, in the British Office.
